resetConfirmDetail: MyClip could not read its settings, so it stopped capturing. Resetting restores the defaults — your ignored apps, types and patterns are lost — and capture starts again. The unreadable file is kept beside the new one.
aboutDetail: A local-only clipboard history for the menu bar, after Maccy. Nothing you copy leaves this Mac.
shortcutTaken: The shortcut {shortcut} is taken by another app.
prefShortcutsDescription: Open works anywhere; Pin, Delete and Preview work in the popup.
prefModifiers:
Customize the behavior when selecting item:
• Select with {copy} pressed to copy item.
• Select with {paste} pressed to copy and paste item.
• Select with {plain} pressed to copy, clear formatting, and paste item.
prefAccessibility: Pasting needs Accessibility access: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.
prefSaveDescription: Change what types of copied content should be stored.
prefSizeDescription: Number of history items to keep (pinned items do not count). Default: 200.
prefImageHeightDescription: Maximum image preview height. Default: 40. Set to 16 to look like text items.
prefPreviewDelayDescription: Delay in milliseconds until the preview is shown. Default: 1500.
prefShowRecentCopy: Show recent copy next to menu icon
prefFooterWarning: ⚠️ Press ⌘, (command+comma) to open preferences when footer is hidden.
prefMenuIconHidden: With the menu icon hidden, open the popup with its shortcut; ⌘, in the popup opens these settings.
prefPinsDescription: You can change the key, title and content of any pinned item. Only plain text content can be changed; editing discards formatting.
prefNoPins: No pinned items. Press {key} in the popup to pin one.
prefIgnoredAppsDescription: Ignore copies coming from certain applications. This is not bullet-proof: prefer pasteboard types when possible.
prefIgnoredTypesDescription: Ignore certain pasteboard types. Some known application-specific types are listed by default; remove them or add your own.
prefIgnoredRegexpsDescription: Ignore copies whose text matches one of these regular expressions.
prefTurnOffDescription: Temporarily ignore all new copies, for example while copying sensitive data.
prefTurnOffViaMenuIcon: You can also click the menu icon with ⌥ pressed. To ignore only the next copy, click with ⌥⇧.
prefClearOnQuitDescription: Remove all unpinned items before quitting.
prefClearSystemClipboardDescription: Clearing the history also clears the current system clipboard.
prefCheckIntervalDescription: How often MyClip looks for new copies, in milliseconds. Default: 500.
prefLocalOnly: Everything stays on this Mac: no network, no telemetry.
